entries.name: Neovim / Terminal IDE Profile
entries.author: genubar-community
entries.description: Adds quick File/Buffers/Split/Search top-level organization when Neovim runs inside a terminal window.
entries.content:
id = "vim_navigation_profile"
name = "Neovim / Terminal IDE"
version = "1.0.0"
author = "genubar-community"
description = "Custom panel layout for Neovim sessions"
min_app_version = "0.1.0"
enabled = true
priority = 15
sync_new_items = true
include_app_system_column = true

[[matchers]]
field = "title"
contains = "nvim"

[[columns]]
type = "inherit"
from = "File"

[[columns]]
type = "inherit"
from = "Edit"

[[columns]]
type = "inherit"
from = "View"

[[columns]]
type = "inherit_others"
